title: Okay Box
text:
I was excited at the prospect of this box, based on the fun bags and items shown in the photos. When my first one arrived, it was just stuffed into a Priority-type mailer envelope. I was half expecting something to be broken. Putting that aside, I opened it and was a bit disappointed; instead of a super cute little makeup bag, it was in a cheap looking little bag that had ‘sassiest’ on it. I loved the unicorn snot gloss’ feel but I wouldn’t realistically wear green glitter gloss. There was a lip contour, a matte liquid and another gloss. None in my color preferences, but I know that happens with a surprise box. I decided to give it another try, just in case this bag was a bad representation of their offering; don’t forget, I *had* seen the pictures showing other offerings.

Imagine my surprise when the second month, I get the same exact cheap looking bag. Nothing cutesy or adorable for Christmas nor one for New Year’s. Nothing remarkable inside, with more colors that I will have to struggle to make work for me.

When the third one arrived, and was basically a repeat of the first two, I decided to cancel. I don’t think I got a single color that works for me, by itself, in any of it.

Of course, I didn’t cancel until after the cutoff day, so I got my fourth one in today. STILL the same type of cheap looking bag, this time it contains a tube of chapstick type of product and an beautiful gold eyeshadow, in addition to a gloss and matte liquid. I like the eye shadow already, but a chapstick-esque product?!? I can get that at the dollar store, folks! I haven’t opened the other products to check their colors yet, but I’m not eager to any more.

If any of my bags had been adorable and any of the lipsticks really usable for me, it would have been worth it. 🙁 As it stands, even my daughter, whose skin coloring and tone work with almost ever color out there, doesn’t even think many would work for her!

I wanted to love this subscription box but I just can’t.
